create_remotable_class: create a Remotable subclass with remote_method decorated functions for RPC calls
build_remote_server: build a Server instance and register a Remotable service with add_service
create_remote_client: create a remote client using make_remote to connect to a running server
run_batch_remote_calls: run async batch remote method calls with tensor or scalar arguments
test_remote_adder: test the Adder class by calling add and batch_add methods remotely
